entities.name: Macher
entities.description: A human cathar of Innistrad who doubted Avacyn's divinity.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: A divine angel of Innistrad who has begun her descent into madness.

events.summary: Macher prays that Avacyn be true and summons her, but she intimidates him thoroughly and flies away.
events.quote: his prayer that she be true summoned her to him

events.summary: Macher lies huddled through the night, certain of the nature of his god.
events.quote: He lay there huddled through the night
